typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		ADFId__c as string,
		Notes__c as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: false,
	validateSchema: true,
	ignoreNoFilesFound: false,
	wildcardPaths:['raw/notes_Contact.csv']) ~> notesContact
source(output(
		Id as string,
		ADFId__c as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: false,
	validateSchema: true,
	ignoreNoFilesFound: false,
	wildcardPaths:['raw/notes_Contact_Id.csv']) ~> notesContactId
source(output(
		ADFId__c as string,
		Notes__c as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: false,
	validateSchema: true,
	ignoreNoFilesFound: false,
	wildcardPaths:['raw/notes_Lead.csv']) ~> notesLead
source(output(
		Id as string,
		ADFId__c as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: false,
	validateSchema: true,
	ignoreNoFilesFound: false,
	wildcardPaths:['raw/notes_Lead_Id.csv']) ~> notesLeadId
DerivedColumn1, notesContactId join(notesContact@ADFId__c == notesContactId@ADFId__c,
	joinType:'inner',
	matchType:'exact',
	ignoreSpaces: false,
	broadcast: 'auto')~> Join1
Join1 select(mapColumn(
		Notes__c,
		Contact__c = Id,
		Notes_Type__c,
		SObject_Name__c
	),
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true) ~> Select1
DerivedColumn2, notesLeadId join(notesLead@ADFId__c == notesLeadId@ADFId__c,
	joinType:'inner',
	matchType:'exact',
	ignoreSpaces: false,
	broadcast: 'auto')~> Join2
Join2 select(mapColumn(
		Notes__c,
		Lead__c = Id,
		Notes_Type__c,
		SObject_Name__c
	),
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: false,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: false) ~> Select2
notesContact derive(Notes_Type__c = 'Contact',
		SObject_Name__c = concat(toString(currentUTC(), 'MM/dd/yyyy:HH:mm'), '_Member')) ~> DerivedColumn1
notesLead derive(Notes_Type__c = 'Lead',
		SObject_Name__c = concat(toString(currentUTC(), 'MM/dd/yyyy:HH:mm'), '_Medicare')) ~> DerivedColumn2
Select1 sink(allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	partitionFileNames:['notes_Contact.csv'],
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true,
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> insertContactNotes
Select2 sink(allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	partitionFileNames:['notes_Lead.csv'],
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true,
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> insertLeadNotes
